description: Whether a product the person is looking at suits them, judged against their own wardrobe and style profile. Pass the product page link, a link to its picture, or its description (pass the description too when you have it: some shops refuse to show their pages to servers). Returns a verdict (suits you, could work, a stretch, not for you, too early to say), the product described in the person's own terms, and up to three reasons, each citing a line of their style profile or garments they own, plus whether it fills a gap and how many similar pieces they already own. Word the answer yourself; nothing is saved or bought.
name: does_it_suit_me
